lastCompletedStory.title: Uniform titled worker-pane (single reused pane, label per phase)

nextStoryContext: US-003 is the next story to implement (check prd.json for the story with lowest priority and passes:false). The worker pane labeling is now wired: loop.ts sets @cam_label 'implementer' before implement dispatch and 'reviewer' before review dispatch. The pane-border-format #{@cam_label} at session level (run.ts) picks this up automatically for any pane in the session. The worker argv (buildImplementerWorkerArgv) has no kill-session wrapper and no -p flag.

officialDocsValidated.summary: set-option -p sets pane-scoped options; @-prefixed user options (like @cam_label) can be set at pane level. API confirmed correct.
